main_measure.name: OLS slope of 5-day excess return on the mom28 post-pipeline forecast, pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 (with top-minus-bottom fifth > 0); reject if t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive; at least 300 grid cases

supporting_check.name: mean excess 5-day return, top fifth minus bottom fifth of forecasts

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and the top-minus-bottom-fifth excess return difference is above 0.
reading: Grid cases are window rows 0, 5, 10, ... with a full in-window 5-bar forward return; the coin's mean is taken over all its grid cases in all windows; the top and bottom fifths are the floor(n/5) highest and lowest forecasts after a stable sort; the plan's 'fewer than 300 is inconclusive' is reported as 'not observable' as the workflow requires.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
